hero.name: DHRUV BHADHOTIYA
hero.tagline: Building intelligent systems that actually work in the real world.

lines: I'm a B.Tech (Hons.) Computer Science student specializing in AI & Analytics, and an ML researcher at CSIR–Fourth Paradigm Institute.
I work at the intersection of machine learning and security — graph neural networks, anomaly detection, and systems for the real world.
I like turning research into working software, from OCR-to-LLM grading platforms to fully offline multimodal assistants.

now.building: E-GraphSAGE — a GNN-based network intrusion detection system at CSIR-4PI
now.learning: distributed systems, graph ML, and writing papers that people actually read
now.listening: lo-fi loops and the hum of a good GPU fan
now.note: Preparing a paper for IEEE ANTS 2026 (IIT Roorkee). Open to research collaborations.

projects.name: SmartEval-AI
projects.desc: OCR-to-LLM exam grading platform. Flask + JWT + RBAC backend, Celery/Redis async processing, LM Studio-hosted LLM. Cut manual evaluation effort by ~80%.

projects.name: NOVA AI
projects.desc: Fully offline multimodal classroom assistant with text, voice and image inputs — local Phi-2 LLM, speech-to-text and BLIP captioning, optimized with OpenVINO.

projects.name: Multilingual Review Analysis
projects.desc: Multilingual sentiment analysis and topic modeling app. Integrated Ollama's gpt-oss:120b to generate insights and exportable dashboards from reviews across languages.

projects.name: E-GraphSAGE
projects.desc: GNN-based network intrusion detection (research at CSIR-4PI). Dual-specialist ensemble + focal loss on 2.5M-record UNSW-NB15 and CICIDS2018.
